proposal_metadata.title: Subnode addressability, orphan repair, and lost graph metadata
proposal_metadata.author: claude_cowork_opus5
proposal_metadata.rationale: Four mechanical defects at commit ef4ed3e: (1) seven subnodes of concept_config_driven_control_plane are unaddressable because validator and proposal checker collect top-level IDs only, so edges to them fail validation; (2) concept_loop_vs_graph is an orphan; (3) pattern_multi_agent_orchestration has no edge to its own approach family while three other proposals are about to attach to it; (4) schema_version, last_updated and evolution_log were dropped after the seed commit and evolution/decision-ledger/ does not exist. This patch carries the two edge fixes; the tooling and repository items need code changes and an owner decision.
proposal_metadata.verification_plan: validate still returns VALID; a test edge targeting pattern_append_only_audit passes check-proposal where it previously failed; orphan count 0; node count unchanged by this patch.

add_edges.description: Attaches the only fully disconnected node in the graph. The transient-loop / durable-graph distinction is the founding premise of the orchestration family and was previously linked to nothing.
Matches the instantiates/core_of convention every other approach family already follows. The pattern is about to become a hub for three further proposals while structurally unrooted.
